// Bannerlord.ButterLib.ExceptionHandler.BEWPatch
using System;

private static void Finalizer(Exception? __exception)
{
	if (__exception != null)
	{
		ExceptionHandlerSubSystem? instance = ExceptionHandlerSubSystem.Instance;
		if (instance == null || !instance.DisableWhenDebuggerIsAttached || !IsDebuggerAttached())
		{
			ExceptionReporter.Show(__exception);
		}
	}
}

// BetterExceptionWindow.Patches.OnApplicationTickPatch
using System;
using System.Windows.Forms;
using HarmonyLib;

[HarmonyPriority(800)]
private static Exception Finalizer(Exception __exception)
{
	if (__exception != null)
	{
		ErrorWindow errorWindow = new ErrorWindow();
		ErrorWindow.exceptionData = __exception;
		if (errorWindow.ShowDialog() == DialogResult.Retry)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	return __exception;
}
